# ted

> ted is a fast, lightweight, native, open source text editor for Linux, Windows and macOS. It opens a 100 MB log in under 100 ms, browses folders of a hundred thousand files at once, highlights code and logs, and does no work while idle. No account, no telemetry; the settings are a plain text file.

ted is written in Rust on gpui, the GPU accelerated UI framework of the Zed editor, with its own text engine: a rope buffer and an editor element that lays out and paints only the visible lines.

## Website

- [Home](https://ted.tanis.codes/): features and screenshots.
- [Download](https://ted.tanis.codes/install.html): the Windows installer and portable zip, the macOS disk image, and the Linux deb, rpm, Arch package, AppImage and tarball.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://ted.tanis.codes/docs/): What ted is, what it is good at, and where to start in this documentation.
- [Installation](https://ted.tanis.codes/docs/installation.html): How to install ted on Windows, macOS and Linux, put it on the PATH, and build it from source.
- [Quick start](https://ted.tanis.codes/docs/quick-start.html): Open a file or a folder, edit, find, save and change the settings, in a few minutes.
- [The interface](https://ted.tanis.codes/docs/interface.html): A tour of the ted window: title bar, explorer, tabs, editor, minimap and status bar.
- [Editing text](https://ted.tanis.codes/docs/editing.html): Moving, selecting, the clipboard, undo, indentation and line endings in ted.
- [Folders and tabs](https://ted.tanis.codes/docs/folders-and-tabs.html): Working on a folder in ted: the explorer, tabs, switching and closing them.
- [Git](https://ted.tanis.codes/docs/git.html): The Git panel of ted: see what changed in a folder, stage, discard and commit.
- [Find in file](https://ted.tanis.codes/docs/find.html): Find text in the open file: the find bar, the match counter, case sensitivity and big files.
- [Syntax highlighting](https://ted.tanis.codes/docs/highlighting.html): The languages ted highlights, how it detects them, and how it handles logs and big files.
- [Big files and logs](https://ted.tanis.codes/docs/big-files.html): How ted opens, scrolls and searches files of hundreds of megabytes.
- [Saving and changes on disk](https://ted.tanis.codes/docs/saving.html): How ted saves, how new documents work, what it cleans up, and how it protects unsaved changes and files changed by other programs.
- [Keyboard shortcuts](https://ted.tanis.codes/docs/keyboard-shortcuts.html): Every keyboard shortcut of ted on Windows, Linux and macOS.
- [Settings](https://ted.tanis.codes/docs/settings.html): Every setting of ted, its default, and the settings.toml file.
- [Command line](https://ted.tanis.codes/docs/command-line.html): Running ted from a terminal: opening files and folders, options and environment variables.
- [Files and folders](https://ted.tanis.codes/docs/files-and-folders.html): Where ted keeps its settings, its recent files list and its log file on each system.
- [Troubleshooting](https://ted.tanis.codes/docs/troubleshooting.html): What to do when ted does not start, a file does not open, or something looks wrong.

## Project

- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/tanisperez/ted): the README covers building from source.
- [Releases](https://github.com/tanisperez/ted/releases): every download, with SHA-256 checksums.
- [Issues](https://github.com/tanisperez/ted/issues): bug reports and feature requests.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/tanisperez/ted/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): the crates and how a file is loaded, painted and saved.
- [Performance](https://github.com/tanisperez/ted/blob/main/docs/performance.md): the targets and the measured numbers.
